answer: Operator Collateral Lease. An identity registers by leasing compute from a shared vault that records the operator's real settlement account, not the wallet. Each new identity draws a fresh lease priced against the operator's outstanding liability, so N registrations inflate one operator's exposure linearly. A proven sybil cluster triggers forfeiture of the operator's entire lease reserve, a relic amount they cannot route around because the reserve is keyed to settlement identity. Honest operators reclaim residual lease as nectar over time.
